'''Tarsten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
By [[3637 BBY]], Tarsten became part of the secret [[Order of Revan]] and worked with fellow Revanites [[Darth Arkous]] and Lord [[Goh]] in securing the [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] following the Empire's [[Assault on Tython]]. Soon afterwards he had to report to [[Darth Arkous]] of Republic's own [[Korriban Incursion]] and was redeployed to assist in retaking the Sith Academy on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="FAI" /> During the fighting on Korriban, he came upon a group of captured [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] and consulted on the Imperial strike team on whether to simply release them or force them to fight and die for the Empire.

Arkous was eventually killed on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] while preparing [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Infinite Army]] and sources claimed that [[Lana Beniko]] was involved, resulting in a bounty on her head. Tarsten was quick to believe the claim and scorned her for foiling Revan's plan.<ref name="FAIII">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Forged Alliances, Part III|Via Imperial correspondence to the player}}</ref> Tarsten eventually relocated to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] where a large number of Revanites have gathered and began answering to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ivress]]. Arkous' killer eventually found them out and fooled Tarsten and Ivress into suspecting Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Milenec]] of betrayal, which eventually played into uncovering of Revan's plans on Rishi.

==Behind the scenes==
Tarsten first appeared in game update 2.7 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]]. He also later appeared in the subsequent ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.
